/**
 * database.js
 * المخطط الشامل لقاعدة بيانات Gherbi.Ai POS (46 جدولاً، فهارس الأداء، مشغلات المزامنة والمخزون،
 * القاموس الجزائري لباركود 613، نظام البيع بالتقسيط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير)
 */

'use strict';

const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { attachWriteQueue } = require('./db-write-queue');
const { installSoftDeleteShim } = require('./soft-delete');
const { installDataRevisionHook, tracker: dataRevisionTracker } = require('./data-revision');

function resolveDatabaseFilePath() {
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      const dir = app.getPath('userData');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      return path.join(dir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  if (!fs.existsSync(fallbackDir)) fs.mkdirSync(fallbackDir, { recursive: true });
  return path.join(fallbackDir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
}

const dbPath = resolveDatabaseFilePath();
const db = new sqlite3.Database(dbPath);

attachWriteQueue(db);
installSoftDeleteShim(db);
installDataRevisionHook(db);

const SYNCED_TABLES = [

function safeAddColumn(table, columnDef) {
  db._rawRun(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${columnDef}`, () => {});
}

function createSyncTriggersForTable(table) {
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert`);
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update`);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.uuid IS NULL OR NEW.uuid = '' OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at = ''
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.updated_at, ''), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
        origin_device = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.origin_device, ''), (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id')),
        dirty = COALESCE(${table}.dirty, 1)
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND NEW.server_rev IS OLD.server_rev
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        origin_device = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), ${table}.origin_device),
        dirty = 1
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);
}

function createStockLedgerTriggers() {
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert');
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update');

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id;

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        ib.uuid,
        p.uuid,
        pv.uuid,
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
      LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
      WHERE ib.id = NEW.id AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> '';
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update
    AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND ABS(COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0)) > 0.000001
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '');

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      WHERE COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0) <> 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm
          WHERE sm.batch_uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id))
        );

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'auto',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      );
    END;
  `);
}

function tombstoneOrphans() {
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const childTables = [
    'inventory_batches',
    'product_barcodes',
    'product_prices',
    'product_promotions',
    'product_option_groups',
    'product_variants',
    'bom_recipes'
  ];

  for (const tbl of childTables) {
    db._rawRun(
      `UPDATE ${tbl}
       SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?, dirty = 1
       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)`,
      [nowStr, nowStr]
    );
  }
}

function initializeDatabase() {
  db.serialize(() => {
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
    db._rawGet('PRAGMA quick_check', () => {});
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA cache_size = -32000');

    // 1. الإعدادات، معلومات المتجر، والمستخدمين
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )
    `);

    const setStmt = db._rawPrepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)');
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)) {
      setStmt.run(k, String(v));
    }
    setStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_info (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        address TEXT,
        phone TEXT,
        fax TEXT,
        email TEXT,
        rc TEXT,
        nif TEXT,
        ai TEXT,
        nis TEXT,
        logo TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT DEFAULT 'Cashier',
        permissions_json TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'Active',
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    // 2. المنتجات، الباركودات، مستويات الأسعار، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT,
        family TEXT,
        supplier TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        min_stock INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
        image TEXT,
        unit TEXT DEFAULT 'قطعة',
        color TEXT,
        weight_volume TEXT,
        wholesale_unit TEXT,
        wholesale_qty INTEGER,
        plu_code TEXT,
        has_variants INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_featured INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        material_role TEXT,
        track_serial INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        hide_from_pos INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);
    safeAddColumn('products', 'warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0');

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_barcodes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        price_label TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_prices (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        label TEXT NOT NULL,
        price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_option_groups (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_option_values (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        option_group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        value TEXT NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (option_group_id) REFERENCES product_option_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_variants (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        sku TEXT,
        image TEXT,
        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS variant_option_values (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        variant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        option_value_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (option_value_id) REFERENCES product_option_values(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_serials (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        variant_id INTEGER,
        batch_id INTEGER,
        serial_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'in_stock',
        sale_id INTEGER,
        warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 12,
        notes TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    // 3. الدفعات المخزنية، حركات المخزون، ديون المخزون، الحزم، والعروض
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory_batches (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        variant_id INTEGER,
        stock REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        cost_price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        selling_price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        wholesale_price REAL,
        expiry_date TEXT,
        location TEXT,
        display_code TEXT,
        supplier_id INTEGER,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT NOT NULL,
        batch_uuid TEXT,
        product_uuid TEXT,
        variant_uuid TEXT,
        delta REAL NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        ref_type TEXT,
        ref_uuid TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT NOT NULL,
        occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_debt (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        variant_id INTEGER,
        batch_id INTEGER,
        sale_id INTEGER,
        quantity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        resolved_at TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_bundles (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        selling_price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        cost_price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        description TEXT,
        image TEXT,
        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bundle_items (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        bundle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        quantity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (bundle_id) REFERENCES product_bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`

/**
 * شحن تلقائي كامل لملف Lumina_DZ_Products.csv (31,533 منتجاً) في جدول dz_product_dictionary
 */
function autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary() {
  db._dzCsvSeededOrRunning = true;
  db._rawGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dz_product_dictionary', [], (err, row) => {
    if (err || (row && Number(row.cnt) >= 1000)) return;
    const candidates = [
      path.join(__dirname, 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv')
    ];
    const csvPath = candidates.find((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
    if (!csvPath) return;

    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(csvPath, 'utf8');
      const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
      if (lines.length <= 1) return;

      db.serialize(() => {
        /* [V17_SAFE_SEED_SERIALIZED] */
        const stmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
          const line = lines[i];
          if (!line || !line.trim()) continue;
          const parts = line.split(',');
          const barcode = String(parts[0] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const name = String(parts[1] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          if (!barcode || !name || barcode.length < 6) continue;
          const category = String(parts[2] || 'عام').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim() || 'عام';
          const brand = String(parts[3] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const price = parseFloat(parts[4]) || 0;
          stmt.run(barcode, name.slice(0, 120), category.slice(0, 60), brand.slice(0, 60), 'قطعة', price);
        }
        stmt.finalize();
        
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[DZ Dictionary Auto-Seed] Warning:', e.message);
    }
  });
}
autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary();

==================== FILE: db-write-queue.js (13.0 KB) ====================
'use strict';

let activeQueueInstance = null;

function isBenignTxError(err) {
  if (!err) return false;
  const msg = String(err.message || '');
  return (
    msg.includes('no such savepoint') ||
    msg.includes('cannot start a transaction within a transaction') ||
    msg.includes('cannot commit - no transaction is active') ||
    msg.includes('cannot rollback - no transaction is active')
  );
}

function normalizeArgs(params, callback) {
  if (typeof params === 'function') {
    return { params: [], callback: params };
  }
  return {
    params: params === undefined || params === null ? [] : params,
    callback: typeof callback === 'function' ? callback : null
  };
}

class DbWriteQueue {
  constructor(dbGetter) {
    this.getDb = typeof dbGetter === 'function' ? dbGetter : () => dbGetter;
    this.chain = Promise.resolve();
    this.txDepth = 0;
    this.spCounter = 0;
    this.stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      failed: 0,
      totalTimeMs: 0,
      maxTimeMs: 0,
      lastError: null
    };
  }


  getStats() {
    const s = this.stats || { enqueued: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, totalTimeMs: 0, maxTimeMs: 0, lastError: null };
    const avgMs = s.completed > 0 ? Number((s.totalTimeMs / s.completed).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    return {
      enqueued: s.enqueued,
      completed: s.completed,
      failed: s.failed,
      pending: Math.max(0, s.enqueued - s.completed - s.failed),
      queueDepth: Math.max(0, s.enqueued - s.completed - s.failed),
      txDepth: this.txDepth || 0,
      avgDurationMs: avgMs,
      avgWriteMs: avgMs,
      maxDurationMs: s.maxTimeMs || 0,
      lastError: s.lastError || null
    };
  }

  resetStats() {
    this.stats = { enqueued: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, totalTimeMs: 0, maxTimeMs: 0, lastError: null };
    return this.getStats();
  }

  get db() {
    return this.getDb();
  }

  enqueue(taskFn) {
    if (this.txDepth > 0) {
      return Promise.resolve().then(() => taskFn());
    }
    const next = this.chain.then(() => taskFn());
    this.chain = next.catch(() => {});
    return next;
  }

  runAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const runner = database._rawRun || database.run.bind(database);

      runner(sql, norm.params, function onRunComplete(err) {
        if (err && !isBenignTxError(err)) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback.call(this, err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        const resObj = {
          lastID: this && this.lastID !== undefined ? this.lastID : 0,
          changes: this && this.changes !== undefined ? this.changes : 0
        };
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback.call(resObj, null, resObj);
        resolve(resObj);
      });
    });
  }

  getAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const getter = database._rawGet || database.get.bind(database);

      getter(sql, norm.params, (err, row) => {
        if (err) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback(null, row);
        resolve(row);
      });
    });
  }

  allAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const aller = database._rawAll || database.all.bind(database);

      aller(sql, norm.params, (err, rows) => {
        if (err) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        const safeRows = rows || [];
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback(null, safeRows);
        resolve(safeRows);
      });
    });
  }

  execAsync(sql, callback = null) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const execer = database._rawExec || database.exec.bind(database);

      execer(sql, (err) => {
        if (err && !isBenignTxError(err)) {
          if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null);
        resolve();
      });
    });
  }

  dbRun(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.runAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbGet(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.getAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbAll(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.allAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbExec(sql, callback = null) {
    return this.execAsync(sql, callback);
  }

  // توليد الرقم التسلسلي التالي للفواتير والمستندات (db.nextNumber) المتوافق مع server.js
  async nextNumber(key = 'default', startAt = 1, callback = null) {
    if (typeof startAt === 'function') {
      callback = startAt;
      startAt = 1;
    }
    const cleanKey = String(key || 'default').trim();
    const settingKey = `seq_${cleanKey}`;

    try {
      // 1. محاولة القراءة من جدول counters أو sequences إن كان موجوداً في قاعدة البيانات
      let storedSeq = 0;
      const counterRow = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key IN (?, ?)',
        [settingKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => null);

      if (counterRow && counterRow.value !== undefined) {
        const parsed = parseInt(String(counterRow.value), 10);
        if (!isNaN(parsed)) storedSeq = parsed;
      }

      // فحص جدول counters المخصص إن وجد
      const dedicatedCounter = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT seq, value, current_value FROM counters WHERE name = ? OR key = ?',
        [cleanKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => null);
      if (dedicatedCounter) {
        const cVal = parseInt(dedicatedCounter.seq ?? dedicatedCounter.value ?? dedicatedCounter.current_value ?? 0, 10);
        if (!isNaN(cVal)) storedSeq = Math.max(storedSeq, cVal);
      }

      // 2. فحص أعلى رقم فاتورة في جدول sales لضمان عدم تكرار أي رقم فاتورة موجود مسبقاً
      const salesMaxRow = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT MAX(id) AS maxId, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, MAX(doc_number) AS maxDoc FROM sales'
      ).catch(() => null);

      let maxFromSales = 0;
      if (salesMaxRow) {
        maxFromSales = Math.max(Number(salesMaxRow.maxId || 0), Number(salesMaxRow.totalCount || 0));
        if (salesMaxRow.maxDoc) {
          const tailMatch = String(salesMaxRow.maxDoc).match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
          if (tailMatch && tailMatch[1]) {
            const tailNum = parseInt(tailMatch[1], 10);
            if (!isNaN(tailNum) && tailNum < 10000000) {
              maxFromSales = Math.max(maxFromSales, tailNum);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const baseValue = Math.max(storedSeq, maxFromSales, (Number(startAt) || 1) - 1);
      const nextVal = baseValue + 1;

      // 3. حفظ الرقم الجديد في جدول settings (وجدول counters إن وجد)
      await this.runAsync(
        'INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
        [settingKey, String(nextVal)]
      ).catch(() =>
        this.runAsync('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [settingKey, String(nextVal)])
      );

      await this.runAsync(
        'UPDATE counters SET seq = ? WHERE name = ? OR key = ?',
        [nextVal, cleanKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => {});

      if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null, nextVal);
      return nextVal;
    } catch (err) {
      const fallback = Date.now() % 100000;
      if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null, fallback);
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  async executeTx(workFn) {
    const runTx = async () => {
      const spName = `sp_gherbi_${++this.spCounter}_${Date.now()}`;
      this.txDepth++;
      try {
        await this.runAsync(`SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        const result = await workFn(this.db || this);
        await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch((err) => {
          if (!isBenignTxError(err)) throw err;
        });
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        await this.runAsync(`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch(() => {});
        await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch(() => {});
        throw err;
      } finally {
        this.txDepth = Math.max(0, this.txDepth - 1);
      }
    };

    if (this.txDepth > 0) {
      return runTx();
    }
    return this.enqueue(runTx);
  }

  async transaction(workFn) {
    return this.executeTx(workFn);
  }
}

function attachWriteQueue(db) {
  if (!db) return db;
  if (db._rawRun && db.dbRun && db.getSetting && db.setSetting && db.nextNumber) {
    return db;
  }

  const origRun = db._rawRun || db.run.bind(db);
  const origGet = db._rawGet || db.get.bind(db);
  const origAll = db._rawAll || db.all.bind(db);
  const origExec = db._rawExec || db.exec.bind(db);
  const origPrepare = typeof db.prepare === 'function' ? db.prepare.bind(db) : null;
  const origSerialize = typeof db.serialize === 'function' ? db.serialize.bind(db) : null;

  db._rawRun = function rawRunWrapper(sql, params, callback) {
    if (typeof params === 'function') {
      callback = params;
      params = [];
    }
    return origRun(sql, params, function onRawComplete(err) {
      if (err && isBenignTxError(err)) {
        if (typeof callback === 'function') return callback.call(this, null);
        return;
      }
      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        return callback.call(this, err);
      }
    });
  };

  db._rawGet = origGet;
  db._rawAll = origAll;
  db._rawExec = function rawExecWrapper(sql, callback) {
    return origExec(sql, function onExecComplete(err) {
      if (err && isBenignTxError(err)) {
        if (typeof callback === 'function') return callback.call(this, null);
        return;
      }
      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        return callback.call(this, err);
      }
    });
  };
  if (origPrepare) db._rawPrepare = origPrepare;
  if (origSerialize) db._rawSerialize = origSerialize;

  db.run = db._rawRun;

  const queue = new DbWriteQueue(() => db);
  activeQueueInstance = queue;

  db._writeQueue = queue;
  db.getWriteQueueStats = queue.getStats.bind(queue);
  db.writeQueue = queue;

  db.dbRun = queue.dbRun.bind(queue);
  db.dbGet = queue.dbGet.bind(queue);
  db.dbAll = queue.dbAll.bind(queue);
  db.dbExec = queue.dbExec.bind(queue);

  db.runAsync = queue.runAsync.bind(queue);
  db.getAsync = queue.getAsync.bind(queue);
  db.allAsync = queue.allAsync.bind(queue);
  db.execAsync = queue.execAsync.bind(queue);

  db.nextNumber = queue.nextNumber.bind(queue);
  db.getNextNumber = queue.nextNumber.bind(queue);

  db.executeTx = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.transaction = queue.transaction.bind(queue);
  db.withTransaction = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.runInTransaction = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.enqueueWrite = queue.enqueue.bind(queue);
  db.enqueue = queue.enqueue.bind(queue);

  if (typeof db.getSetting !== 'function') {
    db.getSetting = function getSetting(key, defaultValue = null, callback = null) {
      if (typeof defaultValue === 'function') {
        callback = defaultValue;
        defaultValue = null;
      }
      const p = queue
        .getAsync('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)])
        .then((row) => (row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : defaultValue))
        .catch(() => defaultValue);

      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        p.then((val) => callback(null, val));
      }
      return p;
    };
  }

  if (typeof db.setSetting !== 'function') {
    db.setSetting = function setSetting(key, value, callback = null) {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const strVal = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
      const p = queue
        .runAsync(
          'INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
          [strKey, strVal]
        )
        .catch(() =>
          queue.runAsync('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [strKey, strVal])
        );

      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        p.then((res) => callback(null, res)).catch((err) => callback(err));
      }
      return p;
    };
  }

  return db;
}

async function executeTx(workFn) {
  if (activeQueueInstance) {
    return activeQueueInstance.executeTx(workFn);
  }
  return workFn();
}

function getWriteQueue() {
  return activeQueueInstance;
}

module.exports = attachWriteQueue;
module.exports.attachWriteQueue = attachWriteQueue;
module.exports.DbWriteQueue = DbWriteQueue;
module.exports.executeTx = executeTx;
module.exports.getWriteQueue = getWriteQueue;

async function getAllSettingsObject() {
  const rows = await dbAll('SELECT key, value FROM settings');
  const obj = {};
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.value !== 'undefined' && r.value !== 'null') {
      obj[r.key] = r.value;
    }
  }
  const shopRow = await dbGet(
    'SELECT * FROM shop_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1'
  );
  if (shopRow) {
    if (shopRow.name && !obj.shop_name) obj.shop_name = shopRow.name;
    if (shopRow.description && !obj.shop_description) obj.shop_description = shopRow.description;
    if (shopRow.address && !obj.shop_address) obj.shop_address = shopRow.address;
    if (shopRow.phone && !obj.shop_phone) obj.shop_phone = shopRow.phone;
    if (shopRow.fax && !obj.shop_fax) obj.shop_fax = shopRow.fax;
    if (shopRow.email && !obj.shop_email) obj.shop_email = shopRow.email;
    if (shopRow.rc && !obj.shop_rc) obj.shop_rc = shopRow.rc;
    if (shopRow.nif && !obj.shop_nif) obj.shop_nif = shopRow.nif;
    if (shopRow.ai && !obj.shop_ai) obj.shop_ai = shopRow.ai;
    if (shopRow.nis && !obj.shop_nis) obj.shop_nis = shopRow.nis;
    if (shopRow.logo && !obj.shop_logo) obj.shop_logo = shopRow.logo;
  }
  return obj;
}

async function isLanClientMode() {
  const scope = (await getSetting('network_scope', 'local')).toLowerCase();
  const mode = (await getSetting('network_mode', 'server')).toLowerCase();
  if ((scope === 'local' || scope === 'lan' || scope === 'both') && mode === 'client') {
    const serverIp = await getSetting('server_ip', '192.168.1.15');
    const serverPort = Number(await getSetting('server_port', '8080')) || 8080;
    const instanceId = await getSetting('instance_id', 'lan-client');
    lanClient.setTarget(serverIp, serverPort, instanceId);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function getLocalIpv4List() {
  const nets = os.networkInterfaces();
  const list = [];
  for (const [name, addrs] of Object.entries(nets)) {
    for (const addr of addrs || []) {
      if (addr.family === 'IPv4' && !addr.internal) {
        list.push({ name, address: addr.address, netmask: addr.netmask });
      }
    }
  }
  return list;
}

function getPrimaryLocalIp() {
  const list = getLocalIpv4List();
  return list.length > 0 ? list[0].address : '127.0.0.1';
}

async function ensureSupplierByName(supplierName) {
  const clean = String(supplierName || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  const existing = await dbGet(
    'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
    [clean]
  );
  if (existing) return existing.id;
  const ins = await dbRun(
    'INSERT INTO suppliers (name, initial_debt, initial_debt_paid) VALUES (?, 0, 0)',
    [clean]
  );
  return ins.lastID;
}

function createMainWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1420,
    height: 890,
    minWidth: 1024,
    minHeight: 700,
    title: 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      sandbox: false
    }
  });

  mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'));

  if (process.argv.includes('--dev')) {
    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools({ mode: 'detach' });
  }

  mainWindow.on('closed', () => {
    mainWindow = null;
    if (customerDisplayWindow && !customerDisplayWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      customerDisplayWindow.close();
    }
  });
}

// ============================================================================
// تسجيل جميع قنوات الاتصال (IPC Handlers)
// ============================================================================
function registerIpcHandlers() {
  ipcMain.on('get-hwid-sync', (event) => {
    event.returnValue = licenseManager.getHWID();
  });

  // 1. المراجعات والإعدادات ومعلومات النظام
  ipcMain.handle('get-data-revision', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getDataRevision();
    return getDataRevision();
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-app-version', () => app.getVersion() || '3.0.0');
  ipcMain.handle('check-update', () => ({ updateAvailable: false, version: app.getVersion() }));
  ipcMain.handle('open-external-link', (_e, url) => {
    if (url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(url))) shell.openExternal(String(url));
    return { ok: true };
  });
  ipcMain.handle('open-youtube-video', (_e, url) => {
    if (url) shell.openExternal(String(url));
    return { ok: true };
  });
  ipcMain.handle('app-relaunch', () => {
    app.relaunch();
    app.exit(0);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-settings', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSettings();
    return await getAllSettingsObject();
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-settings', async (_e, settingsObj = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateSettings(settingsObj);
    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(settingsObj || {})) {
        if (v === undefined || v === 'undefined') continue;
        const val = k === 'shop_logo' && v ? processImage(String(v)) : String(v ?? '');
        await setSetting(k, val);
      }
    });
    return { success: true };
  });

  // 2. المستخدمون والمصادقة
  ipcMain.handle('check-first-run', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.checkFirstRun();
    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );
    const row = await dbGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL');
    return Number((row && row.count) || 0) === 0;
  });

  ipcMain.handle('setup-first-admin', async (_e, arg1, arg2, arg3) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.setupFirstAdmin(arg1);
    const d =
      typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null
        ? arg1
        : { name: arg1, username: arg2, password: arg3 };

    const name = String(d.name || d.username || 'Admin').trim();
    const username = String(d.username || d.name || 'admin').trim();
    const rawPass = String(d.password || '1234');
    const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(rawPass, 10);

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );

    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );

    let userId;
    if (existing && existing.id) {
      userId = existing.id;
      await dbRun(
        "UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, password = ?, role = 'Admin', status = 'Active', deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = ?",
        [name, username, hashed, userId]
      );
    } else {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        "INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Admin', 'Active')",
        [name, username, hashed]
      );
      userId = ins.lastID;
    }

    const userObj = { id: userId, name, username, role: 'Admin', status: 'Active' };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...userObj, user: userObj };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('login-user', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const username = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.username : arg1) || ''
    ).trim();
    const password = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.password : arg2) || ''
    );
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.loginUser(username, password);

    const user = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id, name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );
    if (!user) return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    if (user.status && String(user.status).toLowerCase() !== 'active') {
      return { success: false, error: 'account_disabled' };
    }

    let valid = false;
    if (String(user.password || '').startsWith('$2')) {
      valid = bcrypt.compareSync(password, user.password);
    } else {
      const sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(password).digest('hex');
      valid = user.password === password || user.password === sha;
      if (valid) {
        await dbRun('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [
          bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10),
          user.id
        ]);
      }
    }

    if (!valid) {
      await recordAuditLog({
        user_name: username,
        action_type: 'login_failed',
        severity: 'warning',
        details: { attempted_username: username }
      });
      return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    }

    const safeUser = {
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      username: user.username,
      role: user.role || 'Admin',
      permissions_json: user.permissions_json || null,
      status: user.status || 'Active'
    };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...safeUser, user: safeUser };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-users', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getUsers();
    return await dbAll(
      'SELECT id, name, username, role, permissions_json, status, created_at FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC'
    );
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-user', async (_e, u = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addUser(u);
    const name = String(u.name || u.username || '').trim();
    const username = String(u.username || '').trim();
    const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(u.password || '1234'), 10);
    const role = u.role || 'Cashier';
    const perms = u.permissions_json
      ? typeof u.permissions_json === 'string'
        ? u.permissions_json
        : JSON.stringify(u.permissions_json)
      : null;
    const status = u.status || 'Active';

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );
    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [username]
    );
    if (existing) {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, password = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [name, hashed, role, perms, status, existing.id]
      );
      return { success: true, id: existing.id };
    }
    const ins = await dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [name, username, hashed, role, perms, status]
    );
    return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-user', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const id = Number(typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1.id : arg1);
    const u = typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1 : arg2 || {};
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateUser(id, u);

    const perms =
      u.permissions_json !== undefined
        ? typeof u.permissions_json === 'string'
          ? u.permissions_json
          : JSON.stringify(u.permissions_json)
        : null;

    if (u.password && String(u.password).trim() !== '') {
      const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(u.password), 10);
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, password = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = COALESCE(?, permissions_json), status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [u.name, u.username, hashed, u.role || 'Cashier', perms, u.status || 'Active', id]
      );
    } else {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = COALESCE(?, permissions_json), status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [u.name, u.username, u.role || 'Cashier', perms, u.status || 'Active', id]
      );
    }
    return { success: true, id };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-user', async (_e, id) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteUser(id);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?', [Number(id)]);
    return { success: true };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-account', async (_e, userId, username, currentPassword, newPassword) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) {
      return lanClient.updateAccount(userId, username, currentPassword, newPassword);
    }
    const user = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [
      Number(userId)
    ]);
    if (!user) return { success: false, error: 'user_not_found' };

    if (newPassword) {
      const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(newPassword), 10);
      await dbRun('UPDATE users SET username = ?, password = ? WHERE id = ?', [
        String(username || user.username).trim(),
        hashed,
        user.id
      ]);
    } else {
      await dbRun('UPDATE users SET username = ? WHERE id = ?', [
        String(username || user.username).trim(),
        user.id
      ]);
    }
    return { success: true };
  });

  // 3. المنتجات، الفئات، الدفعات، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
  ipcMain.handle('get-categories', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getCategories();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(category) <> '' ORDER BY category ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.category);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-families', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getFamilies();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT family FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND family IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(family) <> '' ORDER BY family ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.family);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-suppliers', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductSuppliers();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT name FROM suppliers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name) <> '' ORDER BY name ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.name);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-products', async (_e, filters = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProducts(filters);
    const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [];

    if (filters && filters.category) {
      conds.push('p.category = ?');
      params.push(filters.category);
    }
    if (filters && filters.family) {
      conds.push('p.family = ?');
      params.push(filters.family);
    }
    if (filters && filters.supplier) {
      conds.push('p.supplier = ?');
      params.push(filters.supplier);
    }
    if (filters && filters.search) {
      const q = `%${String(filters.search).trim()}%`;
      conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ? OR p.plu_code LIKE ?)');
      params.push(q, q, q, q);
    }

    const { stockJoinSql, orderBySql } = buildProductsQueryOrder(filters && filters.sort);
    const rows = await dbAll(
      `SELECT p.* FROM products p ${stockJoinSql} WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} ${orderBySql}`,
      params
    );
    return await enrichProductsFull(rows);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-pos-stock', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getPosStock();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(hide_from_pos, 0) = 0 ORDER BY is_featured DESC, id DESC'
    );
    return await enrichProductsFull(rows);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-analytics', async (_e, productId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductAnalytics(productId);
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const summary = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS total_sold_qty,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS total_revenue,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS total_cost
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
       WHERE si.product_id = ? AND si.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [pid]
    );
    const rev = Number((summary && summary.total_revenue) || 0);
    const cost = Number((summary && summary.total_cost) || 0);
    return {
      product_id: pid,
      total_sold_qty: Number((summary && summary.total_sold_qty) || 0),
      total_revenue: rev,
      total_cost: cost,
      total_profit: Number((rev - cost).toFixed(2))
    };
  });

        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [

        ]
      );

      /* [V16_ADD_PRODUCT_PACK_SQL] */

        await dbRun(

          `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
            product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,

            Number(p.cost_price ?? 0),
            Number(p.selling_price ?? 0),
            p.wholesale_price !== undefined && p.wholesale_price !== ''
              ? Number(p.wholesale_price)
              : null,
            p.expiry_date || null,
            p.location || null
          ]
        );
      }

      return { success: true, id: productId };
    });

  ipcMain.handle('get-sales', async (_e, filters = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSales(filters);
    const conds = ['s.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [];

    if (filters.customerId || filters.customer_id) {
      conds.push('s.customer_id = ?');
      params.push(Number(filters.customerId || filters.customer_id));
    }
    if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
      conds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)');
      params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
    }
    if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
      conds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)');
      params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
    }

    return await dbAll(
      `SELECT
         s.*,
         c.name AS customer_name,
         c.phone AS customer_phone,
         u.name AS seller_name
       FROM sales s
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
       WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
       ORDER BY s.id DESC
       LIMIT 500`,
      params
    );
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-sale-details', async (_e, saleId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSaleDetails(saleId);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const sale = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         s.*,
         c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.address AS customer_address,
         c.rc AS customer_rc, c.nif AS customer_nif, c.ai AS customer_ai, c.nis AS customer_nis,
         u.name AS seller_name
       FROM sales s
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
       WHERE s.id = ? AND s.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [sid]
    );
    if (!sale) return null;

    sale.items = await dbAll(
      `SELECT
         si.*,
         COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
         p.barcode AS product_barcode,
         p.unit AS product_unit
       FROM sale_items si
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
       WHERE si.sale_id = ? AND si.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [sid]
    );
    sale.payments = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC',
      [sid]
    );
    return sale;
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-sale-payment', async (_e, saleId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addSalePayment(saleId, amount, date, meta);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const amt = Number(amount || 0);
    /* [V25_FINANCIAL_POSITIVE_AMOUNT_GUARD] */
    if (!Number.isFinite(amt) || amt <= 0.009) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال مبلغ دفع صحيح أكبر من الصفر');
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const sale = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
    if (!sale) throw new Error('الفاتورة غير موجودة');
    /* [V26_SALE_OVERPAYMENT_CAP] */
    const maxDue = Number(Math.max(0, Number(sale.total || 0) - Number(sale.paid_amount || 0)).toFixed(2));
    if (maxDue <= 0.009) throw new Error('هذه الفاتورة مسددة بالكامل مسبقاً');
    const effectiveAmt = Number(Math.min(amt, maxDue).toFixed(2));

    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');
    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          sid,
          sale.customer_id,
          effectiveAmt,
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );
      await dbRun('UPDATE sales SET paid_amount = MIN(total, COALESCE(paid_amount, 0) + ?) WHERE id = ?', [
        effectiveAmt,
        sid
      ]);
      const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, meta.userId);
      if (activeSess && (!meta.payment_method || meta.payment_method === 'cash')) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'debt_payment', ?, 'sales', ?, ?)`,
          [activeSess, effectiveAmt, `تسديد فاتورة بيع #${sid}`, ins.lastID]
        );
      }
      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-sale', async (_e, saleId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteSale(saleId);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const oldSale = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
    const items = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [sid]
    );
    if (oldSale && db.enterprise && db.enterprise.logForensicAudit) {
      await db.enterprise.logForensicAudit({
        userId: oldSale.user_id || 1,
        userName: 'Admin / Cashier',
        actionCode: 'DELETE_SALE_FORENSIC',
        entityTable: 'sales',
        entityId: sid,
        beforeObj: { sale: oldSale, items_count: items.length, total: oldSale.total },
        afterObj: { deleted: true, deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() },
        details: `حذف فاتورة مبيعات رقم (${oldSale.doc_number || '#' + sid}) بقيمة ${Number(oldSale.total || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج`
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      /* [V24_RESTORE_BONUS_SERIAL_PROMO_ON_DELETE] */
      for (const it of items) {
        if (it.batch_id && Number(it.sold_without_stock || 0) === 0) {
          await batchAlloc.restoreBatch(db, {
            batchId: it.batch_id,
            quantity: Number(it.quantity || 0) + Number(it.bonus_qty || 0),
            soldWithoutStock: it.sold_without_stock
          });
        }
        /* [V25_RESTORE_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS_ON_DELETE] */
        if (!it.product_id && !it.batch_id && it.custom_product_name && Number(it.quantity || 0) > 0) {
          const bRow = await dbGet('SELECT id FROM product_bundles WHERE name = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1', [String(it.custom_product_name).trim()]).catch(() => null);
          if (bRow && bRow.id) {
            const bComps = await dbAll('SELECT product_id, quantity FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [bRow.id]).catch(() => []);
            for (const bc of bComps) {
              const restoreQty = Number((Number(bc.quantity || 1) * Number(it.quantity || 1)).toFixed(6));
              const targetBatch = await dbGet('SELECT id FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', [bc.product_id]).catch(() => null);
              if (targetBatch && targetBatch.id && restoreQty > 0) {
                await batchAlloc.restoreBatch(db, { batchId: targetBatch.id, quantity: restoreQty, soldWithoutStock: 0 });
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (it.applied_promotion_id && Number(it.quantity || 0) > 0) {
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE product_promotions SET used_qty = MAX(0, COALESCE(used_qty, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
            [Number(it.quantity || 0), Number(it.applied_promotion_id)]
          ).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
      await dbRun(
        "UPDATE product_serials SET status = 'in_stock', sale_id = NULL WHERE sale_id = ?",
        [sid]
      ).catch(() => {});
      await tillLedger.reverseSaleTill(db, sid);
      /* [V16_REVERSE_LOYALTY_ON_DELETE_SALE] */
      if (oldSale && oldSale.customer_id) {
        const lRow = await dbGet(
          'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_delta), 0) AS net_pts FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
          [sid]
        ).catch(() => null);
        const netPts = Number((lRow && lRow.net_pts) || 0);
        if (Math.abs(netPts) > 0.001) {
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = MAX(0, COALESCE(loyalty_points, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
            [netPts, Number(oldSale.customer_id)]
          ).catch(() => {});
        }
        await dbRun('DELETE FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]).catch(() => {});
      }
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM stock_debt WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      /* [V23_CASCADE_SALE_INSTALLMENTS_AND_TILL] */
      await dbRun(
        "DELETE FROM caisse_transactions WHERE type = 'debt_payment' AND reference_id IN (SELECT id FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ?)",
        [sid]
      ).catch(() => {});
      await dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM installment_schedules WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT id FROM installment_plans WHERE sale_id = ?)',
        [sid]
      ).catch(() => {});
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM installment_plans WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]).catch(() => {});
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
      return { success: true };
    });
  });

       FROM customers c
       LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.customer_id = c.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

         FROM customers c
         LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.customer_id = c.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
         WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL

       )`

  ipcMain.handle('get-customer-credit-summary', async (_e, customerId, excludeSaleId = null) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getCustomerCreditSummary(customerId, excludeSaleId);
    const cid = Number(customerId);
    const cust = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [cid]);
    if (!cust) return null;

    const salesDebtRow = await dbGet(
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - paid_amount), 0) AS sales_debt
       FROM sales
       WHERE customer_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (? IS NULL OR id <> ?)`,
      [cid, excludeSaleId, excludeSaleId]
    );

    const initDebt = Math.max(0, Number(cust.initial_debt || 0) - Number(cust.initial_debt_paid || 0));
    const currentDebt = Number((initDebt + Number((salesDebtRow && salesDebtRow.sales_debt) || 0)).toFixed(2));
    const creditLimit = Number(cust.credit_limit || 0);

    return {
      customer_id: cid,
      name: cust.name,
      current_debt: currentDebt,
      credit_limit: creditLimit,
      available_credit: creditLimit > 0 ? Math.max(0, Number((creditLimit - currentDebt).toFixed(2))) : null,
      exceeded: creditLimit > 0 && currentDebt > creditLimit
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-customer-payment', async (_e, customerId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addCustomerPayment(customerId, amount, date, meta);
    const cid = Number(customerId);
    let remainingAmt = Number(amount || 0);
    if (!Number.isFinite(remainingAmt) || remainingAmt <= 0.009) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال مبلغ قبض صحيح أكبر من الصفر');
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const cust = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ?', [cid]);
      if (cust) {
        const initRem = Math.max(0, Number(cust.initial_debt || 0) - Number(cust.initial_debt_paid || 0));
        if (initRem > 0 && remainingAmt > 0) {
          const takeInit = Math.min(initRem, remainingAmt);
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE customers SET initial_debt_paid = COALESCE(initial_debt_paid, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
            [takeInit, cid]
          );
          remainingAmt = Number((remainingAmt - takeInit).toFixed(2));
        }
      }

      const unpaidSales = await dbAll(
        'SELECT id, total, paid_amount FROM sales WHERE customer_id = ? AND (total - paid_amount) > 0.009 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sale_date ASC, id ASC',
        [cid]
      );

      for (const s of unpaidSales) {
        if (remainingAmt <= 0.009) break;
        const due = Number((Number(s.total) - Number(s.paid_amount)).toFixed(2));
        const apply = Math.min(due, remainingAmt);
        await dbRun('UPDATE sales SET paid_amount = paid_amount + ? WHERE id = ?', [apply, s.id]);
        remainingAmt = Number((remainingAmt - apply).toFixed(2));
      }

      /* [V27_EXACT_CUSTOMER_DEBT_APPLIED] */
      const appliedAmt = Number((Number(amount || 0) - remainingAmt).toFixed(2));
      if (appliedAmt <= 0.009) {
        throw new Error('لا يوجد دين مستحق على هذا الزبون لتسديده');
      }
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          cid,
          appliedAmt,
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );

      const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, meta.userId);
      if (activeSess && (!meta.payment_method || meta.payment_method === 'cash')) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'debt_payment', ?, 'sales', ?, ?)`,
          [activeSess, appliedAmt, `تسديد دين زبون #${cid}`, ins.lastID]
        );
      }

      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-customer-sales-aggregated', async (_e, payload = {}) => {

  ipcMain.handle('add-supplier-payment', async (_e, supplierId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addSupplierPayment(supplierId, amount, date, meta);
    const sid = Number(supplierId);
    let rem = Number(amount || 0);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rem) || rem <= 0.009) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال مبلغ تسديد صحيح أكبر من الصفر');
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const sup = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
      if (sup) {
        const initRem = Math.max(0, Number(sup.initial_debt || 0) - Number(sup.initial_debt_paid || 0));
        if (initRem > 0 && rem > 0) {
          const take = Math.min(initRem, rem);
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE suppliers SET initial_debt_paid = COALESCE(initial_debt_paid, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
            [take, sid]
          );
          rem = Number((rem - take).toFixed(2));
        }
      }

      const openInvoices = await dbAll(
        'SELECT id, total, paid_amount FROM purchase_invoices WHERE supplier_id = ? AND (total - paid_amount) > 0.009 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY date ASC, id ASC',
        [sid]
      );
      for (const inv of openInvoices) {
        if (rem <= 0.009) break;
        const due = Number((Number(inv.total) - Number(inv.paid_amount)).toFixed(2));
        const apply = Math.min(due, rem);
        await dbRun('UPDATE purchase_invoices SET paid_amount = paid_amount + ? WHERE id = ?', [
          apply,
          inv.id
        ]);
        rem = Number((rem - apply).toFixed(2));
      }

      /* [V27_EXACT_SUPPLIER_DEBT_APPLIED] */
      const appliedSupAmt = Number((Number(amount || 0) - rem).toFixed(2));
      if (appliedSupAmt <= 0.009) {
        throw new Error('لا يوجد دين مستحق لهذا المورد لتسديده');
      }
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO invoice_payments (invoice_id, supplier_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          sid,
          appliedSupAmt,
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );

      /* [V17_SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_CAISSE_TX] */
      const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, meta.userId);
      if (activeSess && (!meta.payment_method || meta.payment_method === 'cash')) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'expense', ?, 'suppliers', ?, ?)`,
          [activeSess, appliedSupAmt, `تسديد دفعة للمورد #${sid}`, ins.lastID]
        ).catch(() => {});
      }

      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });
